title: CarryOn-Merge Chest Edition
description: Mod for Carry Mob and Blocks, also with chest merge
body:
# CarryOn Merge - Advanced Item Carrying & Intelligent Chest Management

**The Ultimate Quality-of-Life Plugin for Survival Servers**

CarryOn Merge is a lightweight and performance-optimized addon that revolutionizes how players interact with blocks and mobs in Minecraft. Pick up, carry, and place blocks exactly where you want them—with intelligent auto-merging for chests.

## Core Features

**Carry Almost Anything**
- Pick up and carry single chests, and other block types likes Crafting Table
- Transport mobs effortlessly without damage and lead
- Support for custom blocks and interactable objects
- Keep your inventory free while relocating important items

**Smart Directional Placement**
- Carried blocks automatically align with the direction you're facing
- No more guessing orientation—chests face the player's look direction
- Intuitive placement that respects your positioning
- Works seamlessly in tight spaces and complex builds

**Intelligent Chest Merging**
- Automatically merge a carried single chest into a Double Chest when placed next to an existing single chest
- Instant conversion—no manual crafting required
- Works directly with CarryOn's carrying system
- Perfect for organizing and consolidating storage

## Commands

```
/carryon merge
```

Activates the smart merge feature when placing a carried chest adjacent to another single chest.

## Permissions

- `carryonmerge.use` - Allows players to use all CarryOn Merge features

## Why Choose CarryOn Merge?

✓ **Lightweight & Efficient** - Minimal server impact, optimized for survival gameplay
✓ **Survival-Friendly** - No creative mode shenanigans, pure vanilla-like experience
✓ **Quality-of-Life** - Reduces tedious inventory management and chest shuffling
✓ **Intuitive Controls** - Works naturally with standard Minecraft mechanics

## Inspired By

- [Original CarryOn](https://modrinth.com/mod/carry-on)
